title: Proposal to Review Cap of Coverage Per Depositor under Deposit Insurance
what_it_is: Proposal to Review Cap of Coverage Per Depositor under Deposit Insurance

sections.label: DI coverage limit history
sections.summary: The DI coverage limit was raised in 2019 from $50,000 to $75,000, fully insuring 91% of depositors, now 89%, with MAS proposals due by end June.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The DI coverage limit in Singapore was last raised in 2019 from $50,000 to $75,000 per depositor per participating financial institution.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: At $75,000, it fully insured 91% of depositors covered under the DI Scheme at the time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: With deposit growth since then, the percentage of fully insured depositors has fallen slightly to 89%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: MAS aims to present these proposals for public consultation by the end of June.

sections.label: Restricted phase deposit limit
sections.summary: In the initial restricted phase, depositors are limited to no more than $75,000 deposit per individual depositor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In the initial restricted phase, they are limited to no more than $75,000 deposit per individual depositor.

sections.label: Payout speed target
sections.summary: SDIC targets making payments to insured depositors within seven days after the payout is triggered.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: On the other question with regard to how fast can you make payments – SDIC's target is to make payments to insured depositors within seven days after the payout is triggered.

sections.label: DI fund size and assets
sections.summary: The target fund size is $690 million and the DI fund has approximately $570 million in total assets, built up through annual premiums.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The target fund size is currently calibrated at $690 million and the DI fund has approximately $570 million in total assets and continues to be built up as scheduled, through annual premiums collected by member financial institutions.

sections.label: Reviews and public consultation
sections.summary: MAS will continue regular reviews and will release proposals on DI coverage limits and scheme operational efficacy for public consultation by end June.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, we will continue to conduct regular reviews.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I said that we recently conducted the review prior to the events that happened to look at the DI coverage limits as well as the operational efficacy of the scheme and we will release the proposals to the public for public consultation by the end of June.
